res.postingTitle: SDET Manager, Mail & Messages Automated Testing Frameworks
res.jobSummary: As the SDET Manager for Mail & Messages Automated Testing Frameworks, you will lead the engineers who make sure those experiences are fast, reliable, accessible, and private on every Apple device.
res.description: As the SDET Manager for Mail & Messages Automated Testing Frameworks, you will lead a team of engineers dedicated to the testability, coverage, and reliability of two of the most important communication apps in the world.
res.responsibilities:
Lead and grow a diverse group of engineers to improve the testability and test coverage of the Mail and Messages applications.
Own the design, build-out, and ongoing optimization of the automated testing frameworks.
res.minimumQualifications:
You care about supporting others and growing their careers.
You have a BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
res.preferredQualifications: Extensive experience with XCTest, XCUITest, and Swift.
